planets.name: TOI-1855 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1855 with a 1.36-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-1855 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1855. Its orbit and size follow Schulte et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
